Class CsvInventoryRepository

java.lang.Object
com.store.inventory.storage.CsvInventoryRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryRepository
public class CsvInventoryRepository extends Object implements InventoryRepository
Stores the inventory in a CSV file so data survives application restarts.

File format: a header line followed by one line per item with the columns id,name,quantity,status. Names are quoted and embedded quotes are doubled.

Author:
Mashal and Umaina
